name: HAT-P-7
description: Star of 6,389 K, 341 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: HAT-P-7
quotes.card: HAT-P-7 is a triple star system located about 1,088 light-years away in the constellation Cygnus.
quotes.introduction: The apparent magnitude of this star is 10.5, which means it is not visible to the naked eye but can be seen with a small telescope on a clear dark night.
